- RIC ↔ DCA (Reagan) first
- Then RIC ↔ IAD (Dulles)
- Then RIC ↔ BWI

Typical carriers to expect on this corridor:
- American, United, Delta (often via a hub like CLT, PHL, EWR, ATL)

- Airports and routing (e.g., RIC→CLT→DCA, then DCA→PHL→RIC)
- Dates and departure/arrival times
- Total round-trip price

I’ll compare them for you, point out any red flags (tight layovers, awkward airports, inflexible fares), and tell you which one I’d book and why. Then you can complete the purchase directly on the airline or travel site.</action>
